name: Le Taha'a Island Resort & Spa
positioning: Le Taha'a by Pearl Resorts, the first Relais & Châteaux establishment in French Polynesia, on the Tautau motu facing Taha'a and Bora Bora, with overwater suites and pool beach villas
best_for: Couples on a honeymoon or vow renewal who want an overwater suite or a beach villa with its own pool
Snorkelers who want to drift into a coral garden from the edge of the islet

facts.text: The hotel is on the Tautau motu, with views of the shores of Taha'a and the silhouette of Bora Bora.
Le Taha'a was the first Relais & Châteaux establishment in French Polynesia.
Every suite and villa is built with natural materials and has direct access to the lagoon or the beach.
Accommodation is in Overwater Suites above the lagoon, Pool Beach Villas, and two Royal Villas.
All guest rooms have original artworks by Polynesian artists, some specially commissioned.
The Bora Bora Overwater Suite looks out to the island of Bora Bora and the coral garden.
The End of Pontoon Overwater Suite is the most private of the overwater suites, with views of the horizon or the main island of Taha'a.
The Pool Beach Villas sit in tropical gardens under coconut trees with direct access to the white-sand beach.
The resort has three restaurants celebrating local ingredients and the archipelago's culinary culture.
Taha'a is known as the Vanilla Island; activities include exploring the motus, learning about pearl farming and diving in the coral garden.
The team organizes weddings, honeymoons and vow renewals blending Polynesian traditions.
The resort offers traditional activities and performances celebrating Polynesian heritage.

highlights.text: Guests can drift snorkel, letting the incoming tide carry them from the reef at the edge of the islet into the coral garden.
The Sunset Overwater Suites face due west over the lagoon, the coral reef and the open ocean.
The Tāvai Spa faces the resort's inner lagoon, where water lilies and lotus flowers float, and centers on Polynesian massage.
The Royal Beach Villas with Pool have two pools and access to an exclusive well-being area.
Louis Devienne created all the artworks for the Overwater Suites and Beach Villas.

considerations.text: Views depend on the suite: the Taha'a Overwater Suite looks toward the island of Taha'a, while the Bora Bora Overwater Suite looks out to Bora Bora.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and entertainment options.
